verdict.rationale: Discord's developer docs show a broad API surface (REST API, Gateway websocket events, OAuth2, webhooks, slash commands, buttons/modals, Embedded App SDK) that covers most bot/integration use cases, and a live probe confirms the REST API is real and functioning. However, the evidence never claims or demonstrates full UI-API parity — things like personal account actions, voice/video features, and many client-only settings (Nitro perks, custom emoji-as-avatar, animated banners) are UI-only per the docs shown, with no API endpoints mentioned for them. Missing for 10: evidence of user-account API parity (non-bot actions), voice/video API access, and confirmation that Nitro/profile customization features are API-accessible.
